import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageGaloisGluedModelClass

/-!
# The universal class on a common Galois-stage carrier

For a curve over the original field, transport the glued universal model class
to its direct base change over the common Galois stage. The transport equation
and the ambient chart comparisons identify the selected class.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory
open scoped TensorProduct MonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

noncomputable section

variable {F K : Type u} [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K]
  [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F K] [IsSepClosed K] [IsGalois F K]
  (Ck : Over (Spec (.of K))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 Ck.hom]
  [IsProper Ck.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible Ck.hom]
  (E : Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext Ck F)
  (CM : Over (Spec (.of E.models.M.1))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 CM.hom]
  [IsProper CM.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible CM.hom]

private local instance originalModelTower : IsScalarTower F E.models.M.1 K :=
  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl

private local instance originalStageTower (S : DatG0.FiniteStageData E.models.M.1 K) :
    IsScalarTower F E.models.M.1 S.stage :=
  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl

variable (C : Over (Spec (.of F))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
  [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

/-- For a curve over the original field, the common Galois-stage carrier carries
the transported model class, with the ambient chart comparisons preserved. -/
theorem exists_pic0FiniteStageGaloisGluedClass
    (E₀ : Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext ((baseChange F K).obj C) F) :
    ∃ (S : DatG0.FiniteStageData E₀.models.M.1 K)
      (h : E₀.triple.N.1 ≤ S.stage), FiniteDimensional F S.stage ∧ IsGalois F S.stage ∧
      let Ck := (baseChange F K).obj C
      let CM := (baseChange F E₀.models.M.1).obj C
      let P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage Ck F := ⟨E₀.enlarge Ck S.toFinSubext h⟩
      ∃ s : pic0Subgroup CM
          ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (algebraMap P.context.models.M.1 P.context.triple.N.1)))).obj P.gluedOver),
        ∃ xi : pic0Subgroup ((baseChange F S.stage).obj C) P.gluedOver,
          xi = pic0Pullback ((baseChange.compIso F E₀.models.M.1 S.stage).app C).hom
            P.gluedOver ((pic0CrossBaseEquiv E₀.models.M.1 S.stage CM P.gluedOver).symm s) ∧
          ∀ U : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex Ck,
            pic0Map CM (Over.overSpecMap
                (CommAlgCat.ofHom S.inclusion ▷
                  pic0FiniteStageModelAlgebra Ck E₀.models (Sum.inl U)).hom)
              (pic0Map CM (P.modelChartι Ck U) s) =
                pic0FiniteStageUniversalModelClass Ck E₀.models CM
                  ((baseChange.compIso F E₀.models.M.1 K).app C).symm (Sum.inl U) := by
  obtain ⟨S, h, hfin, hG, hclass⟩ :=
    @exists_pic0FiniteStageGaloisGluedModelClass F K _ _ _ _ _ _
      ((baseChange F K).obj C)
      (inferInstance : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 ((baseChange F K).obj C).hom)
      (inferInstance : IsProper ((baseChange F K).obj C).hom)
      (inferInstance : GeometricallyIrreducible ((baseChange F K).obj C).hom) E₀
      ((baseChange F E₀.models.M.1).obj C)
      (inferInstance : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 ((baseChange F E₀.models.M.1).obj C).hom)
      (inferInstance : IsProper ((baseChange F E₀.models.M.1).obj C).hom)
      (inferInstance : GeometricallyIrreducible ((baseChange F E₀.models.M.1).obj C).hom)
      ((baseChange.compIso F E₀.models.M.1 K).app C).symm
  refine ⟨S, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨hfin, hG, ?_⟩
  unfold Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage.HasModelClassWithComparison at hclass
  rcases hclass with ⟨s, hs⟩
  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨_, rfl, hs⟩

end

end AlgebraicGeometry
